reason: A provider chat turn that ended FAILED or CANCELLED without an answer left only the operator's message in the transcript, so the next request carried two user messages in a row (Bedrock Converse and strict chat templates reject that) and the model never learned which tools the failed or stopped turn had already run, so it could repeat a side-effecting command. Core now saves a system-authored assistant note for such a turn (new chat_turn_outcomes.py; ChatService.record_turn_outcome): 'Response failed/stopped: <reason>' plus the completed tool steps (name, redacted arguments, result summary) and any step that never ran or never reported, bounded to 12 steps and 6,000 characters, with metadata kind turn_outcome, chat_turn_id, turn_status, interrupted and the same tool_results shape as an answer, and finish_reason interrupted so the UI shows it as stopped (#491's existing mapping). It is written by _produce_provider_turn's finally (streamed turns), complete() after _fail_closed_turn, cancel_turn, and SubagentService._fail_unresumable, each before held subagent reports post; it is idempotent per turn and never written after the turn's own answer. Finishing a failed synthesis (prepare_resume) deletes the note so the answer takes its place, an in-place edit retracts it with its message, and _merge_history accepts a full-history client that never saw the note. Subagent reports and messages posted after the parent's answer produced assistant,assistant pairs; the model request built in prepare_async and in context-length recovery now joins consecutive assistant messages (the transcript keeps them separate for the UI cards). The compactor's repair attempt in _request_memory sent [user prompt, user repair]; it now sends [user prompt, assistant previous output, user repair] and keeps the response_format fallback. The UI maps metadata.chat_turn_id of a turn_outcome message to outcomeTurnId and hides that note while it shows the same turn's unfinished reply with Finish the answer, so the failed turn is not shown twice. tests/v3/test_turn_outcome_history.py (13 tests) fails entirely on origin/main; ui/src/pages/turnOutcomeNotes.test.ts (2 tests) fails without the UI change. The listed existing node ids exercise the changed repair, response_format fallback, final-answer resume, cancel/stop, history merge, rewind, subagent post and context-recovery paths.

No native tests: no Tauri or Rust change. No full suites.
